title: Top monomial times complementary inverse monomial
statement:
Let $K$ be a field, let $\omega \in K$ be nonzero, and let $x \in \{1,\omega\}^n$, that is, a vector $x \colon \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to K$ each of whose coordinates equals $1$ or $\omega$. Then for every subset $s \subseteq \mathrm{Fin}\,n$,
\[
  \Bigl(\prod_{i} x_i\Bigr)\cdot \prod_{i \in s^{c}} x_i^{-1} \;=\; \prod_{i \in s} x_i,
\]
where the first product runs over all coordinates and $s^{c}$ denotes the complement of $s$.
replaced:
For $\omega \neq 0$, $x \in \{1,\omega\}^n$ and $s \subseteq \mathrm{Fin}\,n$,
\[
  \Bigl(\prod_{i} x_i\Bigr)\cdot \prod_{i \in s^{c}} x_i^{-1} \;=\; \prod_{i \in s} x_i .
\]
